Fixed software is the wrong shape for logistics, because every team runs its processes differently. Tare is our solution. Combining agentic AI with deterministic logic means Tare fits to any customer but runs the same way every single time. About Tarebase

We're Dom and Felix, the two co-founders of Tarebase. Dom is a former SVP at a global unicorn, overseeing tens of millions in global carrier spend, with deep logistics domain experience from Amazon, Nestle and EY. Felix was a founding engineer at Raycast and has spent more than two decades building software systems. We've raised pre-seed funding from a top-tier European VC and are building our MVP together with early design partners, who will become our first customers. As our first employee, you'd have a real say in both the product and the engineering decisions behind it.

Logistics is difficult to run well, and experienced people are hard to hire. Smaller businesses often pay too much for shipping, struggle to give customers a good delivery experience, and can't match larger competitors' technology or hiring budgets. The software available to them is often expensive, dated or too cumbersome. We want to make logistics less of a burden so these businesses can spend more time selling their products.They're the customers we want to build for: Europe alone has around 26 million SMEs, employing more than 100 million people.

Just putting a chat interface and GPT-wrapper on top of the problem is not what we're building. We're combining extraction and analysis, workflow automation, agentic and compiled AI with deterministic, verifiable logic. Recent advances in AI make more of this possible, but building a system that does it reliably is still hard. We're looking for someone who wants to advance the state of the art in this area with us.

About you

The description below is an ideal, not a checklist. If you don't tick every box but feel ready for the challenges of being the first engineer at an early-stage startup, we'd still like to hear from you. What matters most to us is that you're motivated, committed, willing to stick with hard problems, and someone we can count on.

You have a strong technical background and a track record of building and shipping software systems, whether that's cloud backends, web applications, AI-supported systems or a mix of these. You enjoy working across engineering and product. You think like a product engineer: you care about UX/UI, and you want direct contact with customers and the people who use what you build.

You'll work mostly in Rust and TypeScript, across the full stack: data engineering, AI, backend, frontend, infrastructure and deployment. We especially value experience with either language from before AI coding tools and a solid understanding of its ecosystem so you can make considered choices. We also value experience operating distributed systems and data-intensive systems in the cloud, including multi-tenant environments and the scaling and security challenges they bring, databases, and durable execution runtimes.

You're comfortable extracting structure from messy documents and care a lot about data quality. You experiment, measure the results, question your assumptions, and keep going until you've found a solution that really holds up.

You can turn that work into shipped software, taking a product idea or technical direction through design and implementation without waiting for someone to assign you a ticket. How to apply

Apply with the button on this page.

Please ensure to use a hand-written CV. We read every application ourselves. It's fine to use tools for spelling or translation, but we want to hear your voice.

Our process

The process should take a few weeks from start to finish depending on your availability.

  1. Application review. If we love your resume we will send over some short questions.

  2. Intro call with Dom and Felix. An informal conversation about the role, the technology and what you're looking for.

  3. Technical deep dive with Felix. We talk briefly about a system you’ve worked on (no need to share anything confidential), then work through a system design problem together.

  4. Half a day with us in Munich or London. We cover your travel, hotel if needed, and meals. You spend about two hours on a made-up task similar to the problems we work on, using your usual tools and coding agents. Then we have lunch, go through your work together, and talk through a customer scenario.

  5. References and offer. We speak with 1-2 people you've worked with (only with your agreement) and aim to decide within 48 hours.

If we don't move forward after the technical conversation or later, we'll share some feedback with you.

Setup: A MacBook Pro and whatever else you need to work well. If you'd rather not work from home, we'll pay for a coworking space near you.

title: Pflichtpraktikum Online Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
description: In der Rolle des Online Marketing Managers (m/w/d) kalkulierst und steuerst du die Werbebudgets unserer Kunden. Ziel ist es die bestmögliche Sichtbarkeit mit einem vorgegebenen Budget zu erreichen. Um die Fortschritte der Arbeit auch dem Kunden zu übermitteln, werden regelmäßig Auswertungen erstellt. Auch die Positionierung der Produkte an gewünschten Werbeplätzen spielt hierbei eine große Rolle.🚀 Aufgaben Entwicklung von SEA-Strategien : Gemeinsam mit unseren Account Managern arbeitest du zielgerichtete SEA-Strategien aus und sorgst dafür, dass das volle Werbepotenzial auf Amazon ausgeschöpft wird. Keywordrecherche & Analyse : Du führst umfassende Keywordrecherchen durch und kümmerst dich um die On- und Offpage-Optimierung, um die Sichtbarkeit der Produkte zu maximieren. Kampagnenoptimierung : Dein Ziel ist es, das Potenzial der Kampagnen optimal auszuschöpfen und kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Datenbasierte Maßnahmen : Du erstellst Analysen und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen zur Weiterentwicklung der Kampagnen ab – mit Hilfe von Analyse-Tools behältst du den Erfolg stets im Blick. Reporting : Du erstellst regelmäßige Reportings, um die Ergebnisse der Kampagnen transparent für unsere Kunden darzustellen. Amazon Seller Central : Du bist versiert im Umgang mit dem Amazon Seller Central und nutzt es zur Steuerung der Werbekampagnen. PPC-Preisoptimierung : Du optimierst die PPC-Preise basierend auf vorher festgelegten Strategien und sorgst dafür, dass das Budget optimal eingesetzt wird. Qualifikation Studium: Du bist immatrikulierte/r Student/in. Selbstständiges Arbeiten : Du bist in der Lage, eigenständig zu arbeiten und eigenverantwortlich Projekte zu steuern. Schnelle Auffassungsgabe : Du hast die Fähigkeit, dich schnell in neue Themengebiete einzuarbeiten und Lösungen zu finden. Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit : Du arbeitest gerne im Team und bist kommunikationsstark – sowohl intern als auch im Austausch mit Kunden. Analytisches Verständnis : Du liebst es, mit Zahlen zu arbeiten und hast ein gutes Verständnis für analytische Zusammenhänge. Strukturierte Kommunikation : Du kommunizierst klar und strukturiert – egal ob schriftlich oder mündlich. Excel- und PowerPoint : Du hast sehr gute Kenntnisse in Excel und PowerPoint und weißt, wie man diese Tools effektiv einsetzt, um Ergebnisse zu präsentieren und Daten auszuwerten. Benefits Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Kombination aus Home Office und Arbeit im Büro, für mehr Flexibilität und Teamgeist. Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten: Zugang zu Schulungen und Workshops, um deine Fähigkeiten kontinuierlich auszubauen und deine Karriere innerhalb der Agentur voranzutreiben. Teamkultur: Ein motiviertes, unterstützendes Team und eine offene Arbeitskultur. Ausstattung: Moderne Arbeitsmittel und leistungsstarke Tools für deine täglichen Aufgaben. Ziel ist es die bestmögliche Sichtbarkeit mit einem vorgegebenen Budget zu erreichen. Um die Fortschritte der Arbeit auch dem Kunden zu übermitteln, werden regelmäßig Auswertungen erstellt. Auch die Positionierung der Produkte an gewünschten Werbeplätzen spielt hierbei eine große Rolle.🚀 Aufgaben Strategieerarbeitung: Entwicklung von SEA-Strategien in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Account Managern, um Werbepotenziale auf Amazon optimal auszuschöpfen und auszubauen. Keyword-Recherche & SEO-Optimierung: Durchführung von Keyword-Recherchen sowie On- und Offpage-Analysen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Kampagnenleistung. Kampagnenoptimierung: Maximierung des Kampagnenpotenzials durch fortlaufende Optimierung und Überwachung der Kampagnen, um die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse zu erzielen. Datenanalyse & Maßnahmenableitung: Analyse der Kampagnendaten mit Hilfe von Analyse-Tools und Ableitung konkreter Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung der Performance. Reporting: Aufbau und Pflege von Reportings zur transparenten Dokumentation der Ergebnisse und Erfolge der Kampagnen für den Kunden. Amazon Seller Central: Nutzung und Verwaltung des Amazon Seller Central zur Überwachung und Steuerung von Kampagnen. PPC-Optimierung: Anpassung und Optimierung der PPC-Preise auf Basis zuvor festgelegter Strategien, um die Effizienz und den ROI der Werbemaßnahmen zu maximieren. Qualifikation Kaufmännische Ausbildung: Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, idealerweise als Kaufmann/-frau für E-Commerce oder in einem ähnlichen Bereich. Selbstständige Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und bist in der Lage, Aufgaben effizient und selbstständig zu bewältigen. Schnelle Auffassungsgabe: Du hast die Fähigkeit, dich schnell in neue Themenfelder einzuarbeiten und komplexe Zusammenhänge zu verstehen. Team- und Kommunikationsstärke: Du arbeitest gerne im Team und bist in der Lage, dich klar und präzise schriftlich sowie mündlich zu äußern. Analytisches Denken: Ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Zahlen und die Fähigkeit, datenbasierte Entscheidungen zu treffen, zeichnen dich aus. Strukturierte Kommunikation: Deine schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikation ist klar und gut organisiert. Technisches Know-how: Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Excel und PowerPoint gehören zu deinem Repertoire, um Kampagnenanalysen und Präsentationen professionell zu erstellen. Benefits Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Kombination aus Home Office und Arbeit im Büro, für mehr Flexibilität und Teamgeist. Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten: Zugang zu Schulungen und Workshops, um deine Fähigkeiten kontinuierlich auszubauen und deine Karriere innerhalb der Agentur voranzutreiben. Teamkultur: Ein motiviertes, unterstützendes Team und eine offene Arbeitskultur. Ausstattung : Moderne Arbeitsmittel und leistungsstarke Tools für deine täglichen Aufgaben. title: E-Commerce Marketplace Manager (m/w/d)
description: Du liebst das dynamische E-Commerce-Game und brennst für Plattformen wie Walmart, Bol, Otto, eBay und Kaufland? Dann passt du perfekt zu uns. Wir suchen jemanden, der Marktplätze nicht nur versteht, sondern sie aktiv steuert, optimiert und skaliert. Als Marketplace Manager (m/w/d) übernimmst du die operative und strategische Führung verschiedener Marktplatz-Accounts. Du sorgst für maximale Sichtbarkeit, optimierst Listings bis ins kleinste Detail, steuerst Werbekampagnen und hebst die Performance unserer Kund*innen auf das nächste Level. Fühlst du dich angesprochen? Dann bist du hier genau richtig! Aufgaben Marktplatz-Management mit Weitblick: Du steuerst und betreust die Accounts auf Plattformen wie Amazon, Otto, eBay und Kaufland eigenverantwortlich – vom Tagesgeschäft bis zur langfristigen Roadmap. Listing- & Conversion-Optimierung: Du optimierst Produktdaten, Keywords, Titel, Bullet Points und A+/Rich Content, um Rankings und Conversion Rates stetig zu steigern. Performance & Advertising: Du setzt gezielte Werbekampagnen (z. B. Sponsored Ads) auf, steuerst Budgets effizient aus und optimierst kontinuierlich auf ROAS, ACoS und Umsatz. Sortiment & Buy-Box-Management: Du behältst Lagerbestände, Buy-Box-Anteile, Preisstrategien sowie Kundenfeedback im Auge und reagierst schnell auf Marktbewegungen. Zahlen & Learnings teilen: Du analysierst die Performance-Daten aller Kanäle, erstellst aussagekräftige Reportings und leitest daraus klare Handlungsempfehlungen ab. Qualifikation Du bringst fundierte praktische Erfahrung im Marktplatz-Management mit – insbesondere im Amazon-Ökosystem (Seller/Vendor Central); Erfahrungen mit Otto, eBay oder Kaufland sind ein klares Plus. Du beherrschst Marktplatz-Tools (z. B. Helium 10, Jungle Scout oder ähnliche Analytics- & Repricing-Tools) und verstehst die Algorithmen hinter der Plattformsuche. Du hast ein starkes Zahlenverständnis und weißt genau, wie du KPIs wie TACoS, CVR, CTR und Buy-Box-Raten interpretierst und steuerst. Du arbeitest analytisch, detailorientiert und packst technische Herausforderungen wie Datenfeed-Fehler oder Ticketeröffnungen strukturiert an. Du bist kommunikativ, denkst unternehmerisch und hast Freude daran, Marken im Plattformgeschäft nachhaltig wachsen zu lassen. Benefits Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Kombination aus Home Office und Arbeit im Büro, für mehr Flexibilität und Teamgeist. Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten: Zugang zu Schulungen und Workshops, um deine Fähigkeiten kontinuierlich auszubauen und deine Karriere innerhalb der Agentur voranzutreiben. You might call yourself a design engineer, creative technologist or even a full-stack product engineer who cares about craft. Here you’ll be someone who builds real infrastructure specifically in service of brand and creative output, working alongside brand designers who owns taste and direction.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

What you'll do

In one sentence: build the front-end surfaces and the AI-generation systems that let Lovable’s brand team produce at scale without losing its taste.

  • Build pipelines connecting image/video generation APIs, internal tooling, and the systems brand and marketing already use (Lovable, Design tools, CMS, the marketing site, Slack)

  • Build internal apps for the brand team - plausibly on Lovable itself, which is both a good dogfooding story and just the fastest way to do it

  • Own reliability and versioning for the AI-generation system so brand output doesn't silently drift in quality or style over time

  • Work closely with a Brand Designer who owns taste and direction - you're building the system that lets their judgment scale, not just executing tickets

  • Constantly evaluate new models, APIs, and generation tooling as the landscape moves, and rebuild pipelines when something better comes along

What we're looking for

  • Solid engineering fundamentals - you have a track record of building, shipping, and maintaining real full-stack software

  • Genuine interest in AI generation systems (image/video models, fine-tuning, prompt pipelines) as a technical problem, not just as a user; you’ve built something with these APIs, even if only for yourself

  • Experience translating scrappy explorations into production-ready systems

  • Some design sensibility is a strong plus - you don’t need to be a designer, but you can tell when output is off-brand without it being spelled out, and you enjoy working closely with people who have strong taste

  • Comfortable building for a function with no internal precedent - you'll be making calls with no playbook to lean on

  • You’ll push the boundaries of what's possible with generative pipelines the way our Design Engineers push the boundaries of the web

  • Prior work on marketing sites, design systems or brand tooling

  • Frontend: React, Tailwind

  • Backend: Golang and Rust

  • Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, many LLM and generation providers

  • DevOps & Tooling: GitHub Actions, Grafana, OTEL, infra-as-code (Terraform)

That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

 

The Role:

The way people find information is changing. Search now includes AI-generated answers, large language model (LLM) citations, and zero-click journeys. People often get an answer without visiting a website, so how a brand is understood and cited matters as much as where its pages rank.

We’re looking for an Organic & AI Search Manager to help Paddle show up well in those answers. You’ll shape how Paddle is understood, cited, and recommended by both people and machines. Ranking pages is part of that. Being cited and recommended is the rest. You’ll work across organic strategy, AI discoverability, and content, partnering closely with our Brand, product marketing (PMM), and Growth teams so the content we create is easy to find, trust, and surface in AI-generated answers.

Reporting to the Head of Web, you’ll connect the people who create content with the changing landscape of organic and AI-powered discovery. You’ll turn insight into strategy, and strategy into decisions.

You’ll also help move the work forward. You’ll help shape new content, and you’ll steer business-as-usual (BAU) updates, refreshes, and improvements that strengthen organic visibility, AI discoverability, and performance. Where it helps, you’ll draft first versions for review, using AI to speed that up. This is a broad role for someone who can move between spotting opportunities, making recommendations, and moving the work forward.

 

What you'll do:

  • Own Paddle’s organic and AI discoverability strategy, from brand awareness to category-level consideration, so we’re visible wherever our audience looks for answers

  • Audit our presence across traditional search, AI-generated responses, and LLM citation patterns, then build and maintain a prioritized roadmap based on the gaps

  • Turn organic and AI visibility data into clear content decisions for Brand, PMM, and Growth

  • Work with Creative, Social, and PR within Brand to structure, frame, and distribute content so search engines and LLMs can find and use it

  • Work with PMM to align messaging, terminology, and the topics we want Paddle to be known for, so we’re represented consistently wherever people look

  • Steer BAU content updates and refreshes, drafting first versions for review with the help of AI, and bring SEO and AEO input to new content

  • Define and track the metrics that show real discoverability (AI citation share, share of voice in LLM outputs, and organic visibility trends), and use them to create accountability across content functions

  • Link organic and AI visibility to commercial goals, and influence pipeline through the content and topics we prioritise

 

We'd love to hear from you if you:

  • Have a strong foundation in search engine optimisation (SEO), across technical, on-page, and off-page work, and are building expertise in AI and LLM discoverability, answer engine optimisation (AEO), or generative engine optimisation (GEO)

  • Understand how LLMs surface, cite, and recommend content, and have an informed view on how brands can influence that

  • Have experience working cross-functionally with content, brand, or product marketing teams, and have shaped and influenced how they work

  • Can steer content updates and produce a first draft for review, using AI to help

  • Are comfortable turning complex organic data and trends into clear direction for non-specialist stakeholders

  • Can connect organic performance to commercial outcomes such as pipeline, and explain the link to stakeholders

  • Can balance long-term strategic thinking with moving quickly and testing your hypotheses

  • Are curious about how information discovery is changing and have strong opinions on where it’s heading

 

Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.


Our Values

  • Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us”

  • Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple”

  • Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs”

 

Why you’ll love working at Paddle

We are a diverse, growing group of Paddlers across the globe who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We are a ‘digital-first’ company, which means you can work remotely, from one of our stylish hubs, or even a bit of both! We offer all team members unlimited holidays and 4 months paid family leave regardless of gender. We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

The Operations Lead – UK owns the operational backbone of BJAK's UK business. You'll make sure daily operations, internal systems, and customer-facing execution run smoothly, efficiently, and at a standard that supports scale.

What You'll Own

  • Define and execute operational strategies that support growth and align with BJAK's objectives in the UK market.

  • Run day-to-day operations across customer service, administrative operations, and internal workflows so execution stays frictionless.

  • Hire, lead, and develop a high-performing operations and admin team with a strong culture of ownership and accountability.

  • Own process improvement, finding bottlenecks, automating where possible, and implementing systems that cut cost and increase speed.

  • Lead the customer support function and step in hands-on during high-stakes or escalated cases.

  • Oversee company administration and internal operations, including office management, documentation, vendor coordination, and adherence to internal policies.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong background in operations, execution, or internal business operations in tech, fintech, or fast-scaling environments.

  • Proven experience leading operations and admin teams in high-expectation environments.

  • Hands-on mindset with the ability to solve problems directly, not just delegate them.

  • Strong organisational, execution, and problem-solving skills.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and bringing structure to fast-moving situations.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally and drive execution without formal authority.

  • Candidates who need fully-built systems and processes handed to them.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid escalations, messy cases, or hard conversations with vendors and staff.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

  • English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Principal Engineer
description: <p>Principal Engineer - Contract<br><br>About this role<br><br>The bar has moved. Five years ago a strong engineer was measured by what they could build and how well they could mentor others to build it. Today, with Claude Code and agents, we produce quality work at a speed that would have looked superhuman in 2022 (Podium, PayPoint, Zuto, RL, OAG Analyser and others).<br><br>What separates exceptional from good is no longer typing speed or local craftsmanship. It is the complete package: architecture, deep engineering foundations, communication, system thinking, and the judgement to direct both your own intelligence and AI toward outcomes that matter. <br><br>Exceptional people at this level are not the best implementer in the room; they are the person whose specifications, decisions, and review judgement compound into systems that work in production and that others (and agents) can build on. They are a force multiplier, they hold a room at the highest levels, and clients treat them as the SME by default.<br><br>Your mindset<br><br>The mindset is the engine, and it is almost impossible to teach retrospectively. You are outcome obsessed, not output obsessed and you care whether the problem was actually solved - you resist the ego instinct to admire a clever solution and ask whether it was needed at all.<br><br>You are intellectually honest about uncertainty, taking a trust-but-verify approach and assuming the surprising bug is the one that will burn. You are deeply pragmatic, which matters at CreateFuture where pace counts: you have outgrown the religious wars about platforms, languages and patterns, you hold opinions loosely, and you decide for the systems in front of you, not the ones you wish you had.<br><br>You have a bias toward delivery: the smallest thing that works, then iterate, treating documents and meetings as means to that end. <br><br>And you are relentlessly curious beyond any immediate need, wanting to know how the database actually stores things or why a Claude Opus inference call costs what it does, which keeps you several layers ahead while the rest of the team is still reading the API docs.<br><br>AI as the accelerant<br><br>For a Principal to be truly exceptional, this is now already a first-class competency in your arsenal, not a side skill. An engineer who is brilliant by last year's standards but not fluent with AI is not exceptional in 2026. In practice that means:</p> <ul> <li>Setting AI up to succeed. You treat context engineering as a craft (the right files, specs, examples and constraints), and you architect systems with clean interfaces, good naming, machine-readable specs and knowledge bases so the codebase is a quality baseline AI can work on later. No separate ivory-tower architect required.<br>Reviewing and choosing well. You read far more code than you write, and your value is in the quality of review: catching the silent assumption, the security flaw, the architectural drift, knowing where models fail and looking there first. You pick the right tool for the job (Claude Code for a deep refactor, an inline assistant when that is enough, a sub-agent for parallel work, the right model for analysis versus generation) and you know the constraints differ by client, an enterprise like PayPoint or Natwest versus a scale-up type business like Zuto or OAG.<br>Working with non-determinism. You see where AI moves the bottleneck and help people left and right of you unblock the value stream. You build with AI components but know success is no longer a binary, reaching for evals, golden datasets, structured outputs and fallback paths as naturally as you reach for unit tests.</li> </ul> <p>Technical breadth across the full stack<br><br>Exceptional means depth in at least one area but competence everywhere the system reaches.</p> <ul> <li>Backend: an instinct for distributed systems (what fails, what is eventually consistent, where queues back up), APIs that age well, thoughtful data modelling, and an understanding that languages are mostly syntax differences you can close with AI.<br>Cloud: cost-aware and security-aware by default, reaching for IaC, composing the primitives rather than stitching together managed services and hoping it works.<br>Data: modern pipelines, governance and lineage, increasingly vector stores and embeddings, with data quality treated as seriously as production code because garbage in, garbage out is far worse once AI features depend on it.<br>Web and mobile: past the framework arguments, with a clear view on what you would pick today, and able to build "good enough" front ends yourself with AI.</li> </ul> <p>Full-stack here means seeing the platform as one system and knowing which levers matter most. It does not mean front-end work with a few Node.js servers.<br><br>System thinking, consulting and commercial judgement<br><br>At CreateFuture we work in a consultancy context, where many otherwise excellent IC engineers can struggle. <br><br>You know technology is roughly 30% of the picture; the rest is design, argument and reasoning, commercial and political acumen, and the clarity to frame outcomes for a COO, CTO, CIO or CEO in their own language.<br><br>You know when gold-plating is wasteful, you can name when a project's real problem is not technical and say so even when it is awkward, and you have a strong sense of what is durable versus what is fashion. <br><br>You are not the engineer who introduced the team to seven new technologies last year; you are the one who removed three and quietly made the remaining stack stronger.<br><br>Leadership mentality<br><br>Technical work is necessary but no longer sufficient. By default you raise the level of everyone around you, regardless of discipline.</p> <ul> <li>Communicate clearly and frequently (documents, decisions, post-mortems, design notes); the written artefact is the machine-readable context we can feed to AI later.</li> <li>Make decisions and own them. You don't escalate everything or hoard control, and you are willing to be the benevolent dictator when it is your turn.</li> <li>Mentor in AI fluency, not just code: tooling, prompting and review discipline, so your team is twice as productive a year from now.</li> <li>Need little line management. You communicate upwards, raise by exception, self-resolve, and can be trusted with financial controls.</li> <li>Disagree well. You tell people they are wrong with evidence and no ego, and you change your own mind when you are shown to be wrong.</li> </ul> <p>What we're not looking for</p> <ul> <li>The gifted engineer who sits in a silo. This is a team game.</li> <li>The one who is fluent with AI but ships without the guardrails and quality gates enterprise clients expect.</li> <li>The one with strong technical opinions who cannot justify them commercially and gets defensive when challenged.</li> <li>The pure manager who wants to orchestrate teams rather than get involved. This is about setting a new standard, not coordinating it.</li> <li>The engineer who will not immerse in a client environment. This role will mean on-site work and trusted relationships built in person. We are not going back to working away from the client and being bypassed.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3 id="What-we’ll-offer-you:" data-renderer-start-pos="8044"><strong data-renderer-mark="true">What we’ll offer you:</strong></h3> <p>We trust people to do their best work. That means flexibility over rigid rules, impact over activity, and real investment in your growth both professionally and personally. You’ll be part of a supportive, and friendly culture, surrounded by smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do.<br><br>We offer flexible working, including hybrid and remote options. Our office hubs are located in Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, London and Bulgaria, with occasional travel to client sites or CreateFuture offices when needed.</p> <p>We trust you to manage your time balancing collaboration with client time and focused work. What matters is the impact you have, not how busy you look.</p> <h3><strong>Our hiring process</strong></h3> <p>We try to keep our hiring process clear, fair and respectful of your time. We aim to get back to everyone who applies and we will be upfront about where you are in the process.</p> <p>It usually looks like this:</p> <ul> <li>Call with our Talent Acquisition Team&nbsp;</li> <li>Role specific capability interview&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>Depending on the role, we might also ask you to do a short presentation, a practical or technical task or have a values focused conversation. We will explain what is involved before anything happens.</p> <h3><strong>Inclusion at CreateFuture&nbsp;</strong></h3> <p>We believe diverse teams build better workplaces and better products. We want CreateFuture to be a place where people feel able to be themselves and do their best work.</p> <p>If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just. We will do what we can to help.</p> <p>We look forward to your application!</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
Senior Backend Engineer - Introducer Tech - DE

Hybrid in London / Remote within the UK

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer

You'll own the Lending API in Germany, which banks, fintechs, brokers, and comparison sites build on to offer iwoca's finance to their customers. You'll decide how it evolves and help build the features that make partners choose iwoca.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £5 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

Introducer Tech builds the systems that partners in Germany use to refer businesses to iwoca. The aim is to get new partners integrated quickly and to make applying simple for their customers. The team also looks after how partners earn commission.

Its work covers three main areas:

  • The Lending API. Developing the versioned API and the webhooks that keep partners up to date on their customers.

  • The Introducer Portal. Building the web app that German brokers log in to, to submit applications and upload documents.

  • The sign-up journey. Improving how businesses apply and how well they convert, after a partner referral.

The team is growing to have two product managers, who each focus on either the broker or the partner flow, and three engineers across the backend and frontend, including this hire.

The team currently works in sprints, with three stand-ups a week and planning every two weeks. However, there is room to adapt how it works as it grows.

The role

You'll be the senior engineer behind iwoca's broker and partner channels in Germany, from the tools partners integrate with to the internal systems that broker account managers use.

Ownership and autonomy

  • Own the Lending API in Germany end to end, deciding what to build, when to release a new version, when to retire an old one, and what iwoca can promise partners.

  • Own the developer portal and every tool partners use to integrate, from documentation that their developers and coding agents can build from to self-serve testing that needs no help from iwoca.

Impact

  • Ship the features that make partners choose iwoca, starting with pre-qualification, which shows a customer what they could borrow before they apply.

  • Make integration quick and simple, so a partner can go live with few questions and little hand-holding.

  • Automate parts of the broker funnel and the internal CRM that broker account managers use, cutting friction and the lag between a decision and the action that follows, and building agents wherever they help.

Growth trajectory

  • Set the team's technical direction and shape the product and technical roadmap alongside the product manager.

  • Align designs with the UK engineers who share the API, so German requirements shape the design from the start.

  • As well as being hands on, you’ll develop your mentoring and coaching skills. You’ll help lead the team as the most senior engineer.

You'll work with the commercial colleagues who bring in new partners, and join the team's weekly support rotation.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Backend engineering. You've designed and built production backend systems in Python – ideally with Django, though FastAPI or Flask count too. You've used PostgreSQL or another relational database in production, and kept it fast and maintainable.

  • API design. You've built and evolved APIs that other teams or companies depend on, and made the decisions on structure, versioning, and change.

  • Ownership. You've taken work from a commercial problem through to production – scoping the solution, making the trade-offs, and iterating based on how people use it.

  • Mentoring. You've helped other engineers grow through code reviews and design sessions.

  • AI leverage. You've built agentic workflows, or used AI to scale your engineering output beyond what you could deliver alone. You judge when to use it and when not to.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

  • Partner onboarding. You've helped external developers integrate with an API – through documentation, test environments, or working with them directly.

  • Full-stack. You've contributed to frontend codebases, particularly in React or TypeScript.

  • CI/CD. You've set up or maintained the pipelines that test and release a production service.

  • Measurement. You've used data, metrics, or A/B tests to check whether a change had the effect you intended.

The salary

We expect to pay from £80,000 to £100,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you. At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started. Role Overview Harvey's Finance Engineering team is the investment-side counterpart to our Legal Engineering team: former investment professionals who bring real deal experience to Harvey's prospects and customers. Forward Deployed Finance Engineers lead discovery, demos, pilots, trainings, onboarding, and custom builds alongside our AEs and CSMs. They translate real investment work into Harvey solutions, serving as the trust layer across the entire customer lifecycle, from the first pilot to the most complex, custom-built workflow. Finance Engineers work on Harvey Deals, a new product built off of Harvey's acquisition of Benchmark. Harvey Deals is where investment teams run their deals — screening, underwriting, diligence, and committee materials — built in the firm's own templates and formats, with every figure traceable back to the document it came from. Harvey works with 150+ asset management firms and analyzes 178M+ documents each month; the Finance Engineering team is how that capability meets the way deal teams actually work. Finance Engineers understand how investors think and work, and use that expertise to design, build, and refine solutions that hold up under live deal pressure. In doing so, they don't just drive adoption; they shape Harvey's product roadmap, ensuring every release is grounded in what investment teams actually need. It's a team built to make Harvey the platform investment teams can trust with their most important work. This role is the first Finance Engineer dedicated to private credit. You will build the credit playbook — demo library, workflow templates, use cases — while running live pilots, and lead the credit practice as the team grows. This is an opportunity to shape how we reach and grow a broad range of businesses, from developing an efficient sales motion to helping customers see value quickly and expand over time. You’ll act as the business lead for the segment, with accountability for revenue. You’ll lead and coach the sales team, stay close to customers and deals, and build a repeatable approach that balances efficient execution with the different needs of SMB and Mid-Market customers. You’ll also coordinate the teams that support pipeline generation, sales, and customer growth. Working closely with BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, Revenue Operations, Solutions Engineering, Deployment, and Customer Success, you’ll focus resources on the channels and activities that can best support the segment’s goals. What you’ll do Lead, coach, and grow the sales team for the Mid-Market and SMB segment, including hiring, performance, and day-to-day execution. Own the segment’s ARR plan, forecast, and qualified pipeline. Set priorities with the CRO, review progress, and address gaps early. Define and refine the sales approach for SMB and Mid-Market customers, adapting qualification, messaging, and deal support to each customer’s needs. Build an efficient path from target account and first conversation through qualification, evaluation, close, handoff, and expansion. Coach sellers on discovery, value-based selling, pipeline discipline, and helping customers make decisions with confidence. Make clear, evidence-based recommendations to Product based on customer conversations, deal patterns, and segment needs. Work with BDR and Growth leaders to build qualified pipeline through targeted outbound and other relevant channels. Partner with Field Marketing to prioritize campaigns, events, customer advocacy, and community programs that support pipeline and revenue goals. Work within the marketing leadership’s standards and methods, and ensure programs are well executed and measured. Set direction for how Partnerships can support segment priorities, working with the Partnerships lead on relevant sourcing, co-selling, and delivery opportunities. Coordinate with Solutions Engineering, Deployment, Professional Services, and Customer Success to support effective evaluations, smooth implementations, adoption, and expansion. Share market learning with the CRO and other segment leads, helping Dust develop a coherent France go-to-market approach. What we’re looking for A proven B2B software sales professional who has grown from individual contributor into people leadership, with 5+ years leading sales teams and a hands-on understanding of how to help sellers succeed. Experience selling to SMB and Mid-Market customers, with the judgment to adapt the sales motion to different deal sizes, buying processes, and customer needs. A track record of owning a segment or market revenue number end to end and building pipeline through functions you did not directly manage. Experience coaching sellers, building a reliable forecast, and creating consistent sales practices. Good commercial judgment about where to focus team capacity and budget, including how direct sales, marketing, and partners can support growth. Strong collaboration skills across BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, RevOps, and post-sales teams. High EQ, clear communication, and a supportive but accountable leadership style. Comfort building repeatable sales practices in a scaling organization. French fluency and strong working English are important. The role

We’re hiring a Sales Leader to build Dust’s go-to-market presence across French Mid-Market and SMB customers. This is an opportunity to shape how we reach and grow a broad range of businesses, from developing an efficient sales motion to helping customers see value quickly and expand over time.

You’ll act as the business lead for the segment, with accountability for revenue. You’ll lead and coach the sales team, stay close to customers and deals, and build a repeatable approach that balances efficient execution with the different needs of SMB and Mid-Market customers.

You’ll also coordinate the teams that support pipeline generation, sales, and customer growth. Working closely with BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, Revenue Operations, Solutions Engineering, Deployment, and Customer Success, you’ll focus resources on the channels and activities that can best support the segment’s goals.

What you’ll do

  • Lead, coach, and grow the sales team for the Mid-Market and SMB segment, including hiring, performance, and day-to-day execution.

  • Own the segment’s ARR plan, forecast, and qualified pipeline. Set priorities with the CRO, review progress, and address gaps early.

  • Define and refine the sales approach for SMB and Mid-Market customers, adapting qualification, messaging, and deal support to each customer’s needs.

  • Build an efficient path from target account and first conversation through qualification, evaluation, close, handoff, and expansion.

  • Coach sellers on discovery, value-based selling, pipeline discipline, and helping customers make decisions with confidence.

  • Make clear, evidence-based recommendations to Product based on customer conversations, deal patterns, and segment needs.

  • Work with BDR and Growth leaders to build qualified pipeline through targeted outbound and other relevant channels.

  • Partner with Field Marketing to prioritize campaigns, events, customer advocacy, and community programs that support pipeline and revenue goals. Work within the marketing leadership’s standards and methods, and ensure programs are well executed and measured.

  • Set direction for how Partnerships can support segment priorities, working with the Partnerships lead on relevant sourcing, co-selling, and delivery opportunities.

  • Coordinate with Solutions Engineering, Deployment, Professional Services, and Customer Success to support effective evaluations, smooth implementations, adoption, and expansion.

  • Share market learning with the CRO and other segment leads, helping Dust develop a coherent France go-to-market approach.

What we’re looking for

  • A proven B2B software sales professional who has grown from individual contributor into people leadership, with 5+ years leading sales teams and a hands-on understanding of how to help sellers succeed.

  • Experience selling to SMB and Mid-Market customers, with the judgment to adapt the sales motion to different deal sizes, buying processes, and customer needs.

  • A track record of owning a segment or market revenue number end to end and building pipeline through functions you did not directly manage.

  • Experience coaching sellers, building a reliable forecast, and creating consistent sales practices.

  • Good commercial judgment about where to focus team capacity and budget, including how direct sales, marketing, and partners can support growth.

  • Strong collaboration skills across BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, RevOps, and post-sales teams.

  • High EQ, clear communication, and a supportive but accountable leadership style.

  • Comfort building repeatable sales practices in a scaling organization. French fluency and strong working English are important.

What success looks like

The Mid-Market and SMB segment has clear sales ownership, a focused pipeline, and progress against its ARR goals. Sellers are well coached and can execute an efficient, repeatable motion suited to their customers. Cross-functional support is aligned to segment priorities, and learning from customers and deals helps Dust improve how it serves and grows SMB and Mid-Market accounts in France.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

title: FTTH Security Expert
description: About P1 Security Founded in 2011 by serial entrepreneur and security expert Philippe Langlois, P1 Security is on a mission to secure critical and sovereign mobile networks by providing services and technologies to identify, detect and recover from critical threats and vulnerabilities. P1 Security is one of the very few companies in the world tackling telecom security through pure Mobile and Telecom Security attacks and security from 5G and Cloud-based infrastructure Security , OpenRAN, Network Slicing and RAN Sharing, Edge Computing (MEC), down to legacy 2/3/4G Diameter, SS7 SIGTRAN attacks, GTP manipulation and fuzzing. Our offering and expertise range from Network and Telecom Core Network Security, Intrusion Detection and Vulnerability Assessment solutions, with technology backed by more than a decade of engineering research. We are a lean scale-up, engaged in emerging markets (Eastern Europe, Middle East, Asia), Europe and North America. The P1 Security team includes experts from telecom operators and security companies as well as renowned security researchers who regularly present unique P1 Security research at leading international security conferences & GSMA working groups. P1 Labs, the R&D branch of P1 Security, shares Open Source initiatives with the telecom security community (www.github.com/P1sec/). We are growing the team with people who want to help write it. We are looking for experienced profiles with grounded, hands-on knowledge of telecom networks — and a real appetite for FTTx technologies in particular. Curious, creative and open-minded people who want to dig deep into a genuinely sovereign topic: the security of the mobile networks our connectivity runs on. Job Description If your years have been spent in FTTx — access networks, PON, CPE, provisioning, field operations — and security has always been the question you kept coming back to, talk to us. The role described below does not really exist as a box to tick yet: we care far more about the person than about an exact match with a job title. Bring the part of the picture you know best, and we will build the rest together. What you will do Audits — you will plan and run scoped, authorized penetration tests of FTTH/PON infrastructure: OLTs, ONTs/ONUs, the management systems around the ODN, and customer premises equipment. PON internals — you will dig into GPON, XG-PON, XGS-PON and NG-PON2: OMCI, PLOAM, and how ONTs are authenticated and provisioned. CPE and gateways — you will take them apart: firmware extraction and reverse engineering, exposed debug interfaces (UART/JTAG), hardcoded credentials, update mechanisms and web/CLI management flaws. Subscribers at scale — you will look at what provisions and manages them (TR-069/CWMP, TR-369/USP, ACS/OSS/BSS integrations, zero-touch provisioning) and at the subscriber-facing edge: BNG/BRAS, PPPoE/IPoE, DHCP, RADIUS/AAA, VLAN segmentation, QoS and isolation between subscribers. Convergence and infrastructure — you will follow fixed–mobile convergence (5G FWA, shared core, shared OSS/BSS, unified identity and billing) and review devices and management planes (routers, switches, aggregation equipment, NMS/EMS, SNMP, NETCONF/YANG, SSH/Telnet, APIs, privileged access) against vendor and industry hardening baselines. Threat modeling — you will map attack paths for real operator environments using frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, the GSMA FASG/FS.xx guidance and the MITRE FiGHT knowledge base. Findings and clients — you will turn all of this into clear, prioritized reports with proof-of-concept evidence, risk ratings and actionable remediation, present them to stakeholders, and support remediation verification and retesting. The team — you will contribute to our internal tooling, test methodologies, lab environments and reusable attack playbooks. Preferred Qualifications Deep knowledge on Fixed-line network architecture (FTTx, DSL, Coaxial) MANDATORY: Experience in security audit pentests on OT and IT infrastructure Experience with vendor ecosystems such as Huawei, ZTE, Nokia, Ericsson, Calix, or Adtran FTTH equipment. Familiarity with telecom security standards and frameworks: 3GPP SCAS, GSMA NESAS, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, and ITU-T/BBF specifications. Experience in red teaming or adversary emulation against critical infrastructure. Relevant certifications, such as: OSCP / OSEP / OSWE / OSED GPEN / GXPN / GRID CEH (Practical), eJPT/eCPPT, or CRTO Telecom-specific training (GSMA, Black Hat/DEF CON telecom or hardware trainings) Published research, CVEs, conference talks, or bug bounty history in telecom or embedded devices. If you have a passion for telecom security and want to be part of a dynamic and innovative team, we encourage you to apply and join us in shaping the future of Telecom Security! Language requirements English - fluent speaker French - optional Further details 🏢 Headquarters : Fully remote company, with headquarters in Paris - FRANCE 🏠 Remote policy: At P1 Security, we recognize the importance of work-life balance, and that's why our remote policy is a key part of our company culture. We understand that flexibility is crucial, allowing our team members to work remotely while achieving their personal and professional goals. To keep our team connected, we schedule monthly meetups with department members and gather the entire team on-site every two months. These regular touch points ensure effective communication, collaboration, and a dynamic team spirit, reflecting the dynamic and adaptable spirit of P1 Security. We believe in the power of flexible work arrangements to bring out the best in our team, driving success in a way that suits everyone's unique lifestyle Hiring process First contact call (10-20min) Direct manager call (30min) Capability assessment exercice (depending on position) C-level & Director call (30 min) Specialisations Telecommunications Security, SS7, SIGTRAN, LTE, IMS, UMTS, CDMA, GPRS, OpenStack, Kubernetes, LinuxServers / PNF, Diameter, NFV, Security, VoLTE, VoWifi, GTP, Diameter, 3G, 4G, IoT Security, NFV(i), S1AP, X2AP, Fuzzing, eUTRAN S1AP, X2AP, NgRAN, NGAP, PFCP, 5GC SBI Contact If you are a motivated and experienced professional who is passionate about cybersecurity and driving innovation, we would love to hear from you! Join P1 Security and be part of a fascinating mission to protect critical infrastructure and work alongside industry experts in the cybersecurity field. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Dans le cadre du projet MSDIO , programme de recherche collaborative mené avec un industriel majeur du secteur des dispositifs ophtalmiques (Cristalens Industrie) et visant à développer un nouveau type de lentille intraoculaire (IOL) intégrant des métasurfaces pour la correction visuelle de nouvelle génération, nous recrutons une post-doctorante ou un post-doctorant en métasurfaces et optique visuelle au sein de notre département Optique. Sous la responsabilité fonctionnelle de Vincent Nourrit professeur àau département Optique d’IMT Atlantique et en collaboration avec Cristelens Industrie, vous prendrez en charge la modélisation et la simulation de fonctions de correction optique avancées (IOLs monofocaux, multifocaux ou commutables), le prototypage en salle blanche par photolithographie multiphotonique, ainsi que la caractérisation expérimentale des métasurfaces. Vous participerez également au développement d’outils logiciels dédiés et à la valorisation scientifique des résultats (publications, conférences). title: Public Sector Sales Lead
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>As Anthropic's Public Sector Sales Lead for France, you will be the face of Anthropic to the French State. This is a founding, zero-to-one role: there is no public sector team in France today, and you will build our strategy, our routes to market and our first strategic relationships from the ground up. Reporting to our EMEA South leadership, you will lead the adoption of safe, frontier AI across central government, starting with the largest ministries. You will work hand in hand with our Public Policy lead in Paris, because in few companies is policy as central to the mission as it is at Anthropic, and with Partnerships, Legal, Security and Product to put in place the commercial and compliance frameworks the State needs in order to work with us at scale.</p> <p>This is a senior individual contributor role. We expect you to have run a public sector business and led teams, and to be energised by stepping back into a hands-on seat where you build it yourself and where the size of your team says nothing about the size of your scope. In the first year, success is measured less by a large number and more by putting Anthropic on the map with the French State: a clear strategy, the right foundations and our first strategic agreements.</p> <h2><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Define and own Anthropic's public sector go-to-market strategy for France: where we play first, how we win, and what we need to build to get there</li> <li>Be the senior face of Anthropic to the French State, building trusted relationships with ministerial cabinets, senior officials and digital and technology leaders across the largest ministries, including defence, finance and justice</li> <li>Own the full sales cycle on our first strategic public sector opportunities, from first engagement through procurement route, close, deployment and expansion</li> <li>Work with Partnerships, Legal and Finance to put in place the routes to market the State needs, including resale and partner channels, framework agreements and central purchasing bodies such as UGAP</li> <li>Partner day to day with our Public Policy lead in France so that commercial and policy engagement reinforce each other, and stay aligned with French and European AI strategy and regulation</li> <li>Lead the conversation with customers on data sovereignty, security and compliance (for example SecNumCloud and the State's cloud doctrine), and work with Security, Legal and Product on how we meet those requirements</li> <li>Prove value with customers alongside a shared Applied AI architect, cloud providers and systems integrators, doing much of the groundwork yourself in the early stages</li> <li>Learn from and contribute to our UK and US public sector teams, bringing what works to France and sharing what you learn</li> <li>Create the playbooks, references and operating rhythm that will let us scale a public sector team in France over time</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You may be a good fit if you have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>15+ years in enterprise technology sales, including significant time running a public sector business unit or leading sales teams that sell to French central government</li> <li>The appetite to move from a leadership role into a hands-on senior individual contributor role with no team at the outset</li> <li>Evidence that you thrive building from zero: a new market, a new business line or an early-stage company, where systems, processes and support were not yet in place</li> <li>A track record of landing large, complex and genuinely transformative agreements with major ministries, as the person leading the deal</li> <li>A deep, senior network across central government, and the credibility to engage at director and cabinet level as well as with technical teams</li> <li>Practical command of French public procurement, including tenders, framework agreements, central purchasing bodies and partner or resale routes</li> <li>Real expertise in data sovereignty, security and compliance requirements in the French State, and experience leading those conversations with customers</li> <li>Experience of, or a clear aptitude for, working closely with public policy or government affairs colleagues</li> <li>Ownership and resilience: you treat what is missing as something to build, and you bring colleagues with you to build it</li> <li>The technical curiosity to learn our products in depth and hold credible conversations with both engineering leaders and senior officials</li> <li>Fluent French and English, with excellent written and spoken communication in both</li> <li>Willingness to go through French security clearance (habilitation) should specific accounts require it&nbsp;</li> <li>A genuine commitment to safe and beneficial AI, and the ability to articulate why it matters for public institutions</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>À propos du poste</strong></h2> <p>En tant que Responsable des ventes secteur public d'Anthropic pour la France, vous incarnerez Anthropic auprès de l'État français. Il s'agit d'un poste fondateur, à construire de zéro : il n'existe aujourd'hui aucune équipe secteur public en France, et vous bâtirez notre stratégie, nos voies d'accès au marché et nos premières relations stratégiques en partant d'une page blanche. Ce poste est rattaché à la direction EMEA Sud. Vous piloterez l'adoption d'une IA de pointe et sûre au sein de l'administration centrale, en commençant par les plus grands ministères. Vous travaillerez main dans la main avec notre responsable des affaires publiques à Paris — dans peu d'entreprises les politiques publiques sont aussi centrales à la mission que chez Anthropic — ainsi qu'avec les équipes Partenariats, Juridique, Sécurité et Produit, afin de mettre en place les cadres commerciaux et de conformité dont l'État a besoin pour travailler avec nous à grande échelle.</p> <p>Il s'agit d'un poste senior de contribution individuelle. Nous attendons de vous que vous ayez dirigé une activité secteur public et encadré des équipes, et que la perspective de revenir à un poste pleinement opérationnel vous enthousiasme : un poste où vous construisez vous-même, et où la taille de votre équipe ne dit rien de l'étendue de votre périmètre. La première année, la réussite se mesurera moins à un grand chiffre qu'à votre capacité à installer Anthropic auprès de l'État français : une stratégie claire, les bonnes fondations et nos premiers accords stratégiques.</p> <h2><strong>Responsabilités</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Définir et porter la stratégie de mise sur le marché d'Anthropic pour le secteur public en France : nos premiers terrains d'action, nos leviers de succès et ce qu'il nous faut construire pour y parvenir</li> <li>Incarner Anthropic au plus haut niveau auprès de l'État français, en nouant des relations de confiance avec les cabinets ministériels, les cadres dirigeants de l'administration et les responsables du numérique et de la technologie des plus grands ministères, dont la défense, les finances et la justice</li> <li>Piloter l'intégralité du cycle de vente sur nos premières opportunités stratégiques dans le secteur public, du premier contact au choix de la voie de passation, jusqu'à la signature, au déploiement et à l'extension</li> <li>Travailler avec les équipes Partenariats, Juridique et Finance pour mettre en place les voies d'accès au marché dont l'État a besoin : canaux de revente et de partenariat, accords-cadres et centrales d'achat telles que l'UGAP</li> <li>Collaborer au quotidien avec notre responsable des affaires publiques en France, pour que les démarches commerciales et politiques se renforcent mutuellement, en cohérence avec la stratégie et la réglementation française et européenne en matière d'IA</li> <li>Mener les échanges clients sur la souveraineté des données, la sécurité et la conformité (par exemple SecNumCloud et la doctrine « cloud au centre »), et travailler avec les équipes Sécurité, Juridique et Produit sur la façon dont nous répondons à ces exigences</li> <li>Démontrer la valeur auprès des clients en vous appuyant sur une expertise d'architecture Applied AI mutualisée, sur les fournisseurs cloud et sur les intégrateurs, en réalisant vous-même une grande part du travail de terrain dans les premiers temps</li> <li>Apprendre de nos équipes secteur public au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis et contribuer à leur travail, en important en France ce qui fonctionne et en partageant vos enseignements</li> <li>Créer les playbooks, les références clients et le rythme opérationnel qui nous permettront de faire grandir une équipe secteur public en France</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Ce poste peut vous correspondre si vous réunissez</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Plus de 15 ans dans la vente de technologies aux grandes organisations, dont une période significative à la tête d'une activité secteur public ou à l'encadrement d'équipes commerciales à destination de l'administration centrale française</li> <li>L'envie de passer d'un poste d'encadrement à un poste senior pleinement opérationnel, en contribution individuelle et sans équipe au départ</li> <li>Un parcours qui montre que vous vous épanouissez en construisant à partir de zéro : un nouveau marché, une nouvelle ligne d'activité ou une entreprise à ses débuts, là où les systèmes, les processus et les soutiens n'existaient pas encore</li> <li>Des accords majeurs, complexes et réellement transformateurs conclus avec de grands ministères à votre actif, en étant la personne à la tête de la négociation</li> <li>Un réseau dense et de haut niveau au sein de l'administration centrale, et la crédibilité nécessaire pour échanger au niveau des directions et des cabinets comme avec les équipes techniques</li> <li>Une maîtrise concrète de la commande publique française : appels d'offres, accords-cadres, centrales d'achat et voies de partenariat ou de revente</li> <li>Une véritable expertise des exigences de souveraineté des données, de sécurité et de conformité au sein de l'État français, et l'expérience de ces échanges avec les clients</li> <li>L'expérience — ou une aptitude manifeste — du travail en étroite collaboration avec les équipes affaires publiques ou relations institutionnelles</li> <li>Le sens de la responsabilité et la ténacité : ce qui manque est pour vous quelque chose à construire, et vous embarquez vos collègues dans cette construction</li> <li>La curiosité technique nécessaire pour apprendre nos produits en profondeur et tenir des échanges crédibles aussi bien avec les responsables d'ingénierie qu'avec les responsables publics de haut niveau</li> <li>Un français et un anglais courants, avec une excellente expression écrite et orale dans les deux langues</li> <li>La disponibilité pour engager une procédure d'habilitation de sécurité si certains comptes l'exigent</li> <li>Un engagement sincère en faveur d'une IA sûre et bénéfique, et la capacité d'expliquer pourquoi cela compte pour les institutions publiques</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Logistics</strong></h2> <p><strong>Minimum education: </strong>Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience</p> <p><strong>Required field of study:&nbsp;</strong>A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience</p> <p><strong>Minimum years of experience: </strong>Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position</p> <p><strong>Location-based hybrid policy:</strong> Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.</p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Visa sponsorship:</strong>&nbsp;We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.</p> <p><strong>We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.</strong> Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.&nbsp; Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.<br><br><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Your safety matters to us.</strong> To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit&nbsp;<u data-stringify-type="underline"><a class="c-link c-link--underline" href="http://anthropic.com/careers" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://anthropic.com/careers" data-sk="tooltip_parent" data-remove-tab-index="true">anthropic.com/careers</a></u>&nbsp;directly for confirmed position openings.</p> <h2><strong>How we're different</strong></h2> <p>We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.</p> <p>The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI &amp; Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.</p> <h2><strong>Come work with us!</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. <strong data-stringify-type="bold">Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:</strong>&nbsp;Learn about&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://www.anthropic.com/candidate-ai-guidance" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.anthropic.com/candidate-ai-guidance" data-sk="tooltip_parent">our policy</a> for using AI in our application process.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Une fois ces responsabilités bien maîtrisées, tu pourras élargir ton périmètre à certaines activités administratives de nos équipes People aux Pays-Bas et en Allemagne.</p> <h2>Tes missions</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Gérer l’administration de l’onboarding</strong> : collecter les documents nécessaires, coordonner les étapes administratives et t’assurer que tout est prêt pour le premier jour de chaque nouvelle recrue.</li> <li><strong>Assurer le suivi des documents RH</strong> : préparer les contrats, avenants, attestations et courriers à partir de nos modèles, coordonner leur validation et leur signature, puis veiller à leur bon classement.</li> <li><strong>Garantir la fiabilité des dossiers RH</strong> : tenir les données et les outils à jour, suivre les échéances et relancer les interlocuteurs concernés jusqu’à la résolution de chaque sujet.</li> <li><strong>Organiser le suivi de la médecine du travail</strong> : planifier les rendez-vous, gérer les convocations et veiller au respect des échéances administratives.</li> <li><strong>Piloter le suivi administratif des véhicules de fonction (lease cars)</strong> : coordonner les échanges avec les prestataires, préparer les documents nécessaires et suivre les livraisons comme les restitutions.</li> <li><strong>Être le premier point de contact pour les demandes RH courantes</strong> : apporter une réponse aux questions administratives, assurer le suivi des demandes et solliciter le People Partner lorsque la situation le nécessite.</li> <li><strong>Améliorer nos processus au quotidien</strong> : identifier les tâches qui pourraient être simplifiées, clarifier les checklists et améliorer nos outils de suivi pour gagner en fiabilité et en efficacité.</li> <li><strong>Élargir progressivement ton périmètre à l’international</strong> : une fois les processus français bien maîtrisés, prendre en charge deux ou trois activités administratives récurrentes pour nos équipes People aux Pays-Bas et en Allemagne, avec un accompagnement adapté.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h2>A propos de toi</h2> <ul> <li>Tu es actuellement en formation idéalement en master RH, administration, gestion ou dans un domaine proche.&nbsp;</li> <li>Tu maîtrises le français et l’anglais à l’oral comme à l’écrit. Tu utiliseras l’anglais pour échanger avec nos équipes internationales et travailler sur des documents et outils communs.&nbsp;</li> <li>Tu peux travailler deux jours par semaine, pour un total de 14 ou 15 heures, pendant un an, avec un rythme compatible avec tes études.</li> <li>Tu es organisé·e, tu as le souci du détail et tu suis les sujets jusqu’au bout. Tu sais demander de l’aide et signaler un blocage au bon moment.</li> <li>Tu aimes aider les autres et tu traites les informations personnelles avec discrétion.</li> <li>Tu es à l’aise avec les outils numériques, notamment Google Sheets ou Excel, et tu as envie d’apprendre à utiliser de nouveaux outils RH.</li> <li>Une première expérience en RH ou en administration est un plus, mais nous recherchons surtout de la rigueur, de la curiosité et l’envie d’apprendre.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h2>Avantages Picnic</h2> <p><strong>🍴 Restauration&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Comme nous sommes implantés au centre de Paris, pas de cantine sur place.
